title: Trader Diary: 3‑AM BTC Dip
content:
👀 See BTC slip 0.8% at 76.6k → I open 10× long, whisper “this is it”.
💥 5 minutes later: liquidation notice.
🤦‍♂️ My coffee’s colder than my margin.
lesson: Never let a 1% dip dictate a 10× entry – respect the stop.
question: Who else turned a coffee break into a margin call today? Drop your war stories 👇
